short_description: CLARK Germany GmbH is a Frankfurt am Main-headquartered German insurtech company founded in 2015 that operates a digital insurance manager and licensed insurance brokerage. Through the Clark app, retail customers consolidate, compare and manage their insurance policies in one place, with Clark acting as the broker of record. The integration of the finanzen Group, agreed with Allianz X in November 2021, made Clark one of the largest insurtech groups in Europe.
